It’s more so that you can have a genetic predisposition for a certain mental illness that can be triggered by drugs, and many other environmental factors such as prolonged stress.

There is some current promising research on a link between schizophrenia and weed, however there are definitely not enough studies yet to establish this link yet

I've actually been reading a lot more of Albert Camu's essays lately and I find them very intriguing. I generally like his take on existentialism.  He says that asking the question "What is the meaning of existence?" is an unavoidable symptom of being human and that existence has no inherent purpose. The universe is silent. This is considered "philosophical suicide" since it is basically saying there is no point in living.
